entries.zh: 打损、击打毁损；原典用于「毁损灵性益处」（教会语境）
entries.en: to destroy spiritual goods; to strike and damage

entries.zh: 废弃家业、败毁产业（田产、生计）
entries.en: to ruin or abandon one's estate (hacienda) and livelihood

entries.zh: 崩坏败亡、彻底毁掉；完蛋殆尽
entries.en: destroyed, ruined; finished, done for (acabado)

entries.zh: 毁坏、损坏；原注另一种读法同「损」
entries.en: destroyed, ruined; damaged
entries.notes: 闽语栏「l. sūn」为缩写注另一读法，展开依赖推断，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 四散、散落各处；溃散
entries.en: scattered in all directions; dispersed

entries.zh: 损坏、破毁；原注另有一种读法
entries.en: damaged, broken; ruined
entries.notes: 闽语栏「l. Jūy huāy」缩写读法依赖推断；汉字「損壞」与西语对应本身清晰。

entries.zh: 破其案、毁其主张（17 世纪用法：推翻其说、摧毁其心志；非现代「破获案件」义）
entries.en: to demolish someone's case or claim; to break his reason or heart
entries.notes: 西语注「毁其理、其心」与字面「破案」对应松散，按 17 世纪用法解作推翻其案、摧其心志。

entries.zh: 阁、阁楼；楼房上层居室或储物之阁
entries.en: attic, garret (desván); upper storey, loft (sobrado)
entries.notes: 闽语栏「Lâu cōy. l. cō.」读音与「閣」通行读法不甚吻合且含缩写，按西语 desván/sobrado 与汉字「閣」定夺。

entries.zh: 烂人、下流无耻之人（西语注指女子）
entries.en: shameless woman; hussy, wanton

entries.zh: 面相张扬、神情傲慢自大（西语注：无耻而骄矜）
entries.en: haughty and shameless; arrogant in look

entries.zh: 脸皮厚、厚颜无耻
entries.en: thick-skinned, brazen-faced

entries.zh: 没有脸皮、毫无羞耻
entries.en: shameless; having no face (no sense of shame)
entries.notes: 西语栏与闽语栏尾部「ô xioj／ô chȳ」疑与他行串行；核心四栏（无面皮＝无耻）互证清晰。

entries.zh: 不知廉耻、寡廉鲜耻
entries.en: knows neither honor nor shame; devoid of decency

entries.zh: 打破脸面、掴破其脸（西语注：脸被打破）
entries.en: to smash or slap the face; with the face beaten (cara cortada)
entries.notes: 汉字首字判读存疑（拍/扑），据西语释义与「破面」定夺。

entries.zh: 污辱、羞辱、侮辱
entries.en: insult, disgrace; humiliation

entries.zh: 肆志、恣意妄为；肆无忌惮
entries.en: willful, unrestrained; unscrupulous

entries.zh: 无廉耻、不知羞耻
entries.en: shameless, having no sense of shame (no tiene vergüenza)

entries.zh: 失于教养、没家教（缺乏训诲）
entries.en: ill-bred, without upbringing or discipline (sin criança)

entries.zh: 粗糙、粗劣；原典兼指言行粗鲁无礼
entries.en: rough, coarse (of texture); rude in manner

entries.zh: 粗鲁、粗野；粗率无礼
entries.en: rough, rude in manner; boorish

entries.zh: 口出粗言、言语粗俗下流
entries.en: foul-mouthed, to speak vulgarly or immodestly
entries.notes: 官话对音第二字与「口」不甚吻合，据汉字「粗口」与西语释义定夺。

entries.zh: 粗鲁、粗野（叠言其粗率）
entries.en: coarse, rude
